plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: Dec 1882 & 4 Dec 1890 (Élie Metchnikoff discovers phagocytes with a rose thorn in a starfish larva; Emil von Behring & Shibasaburo Kitasato discover serum antitoxin antibodies, with Paul Ehrlich proposing lock-and-key receptors in 1900) · Oct 1957 & May 1958 (Frank Macfarlane Burnet proposes Clonal Selection Theory; Gustav Nossal & Joshua Lederberg prove one B-cell makes one antibody) · Oct 1976 (Susumu Tonegawa & Nobumichi Hozumi in Basel prove somatic V(D)J DNA recombination generates >10 billion antibodies from modular gene segments, winning the 1987 Nobel Prize).
